text:
Alex: Heads-up — release cutoff in ~6h. Quick checklist: version bump, one-line changelog entries, and confirm release-notes template. Please ping if you have blockers. :wave:

Jamie: quick q — do we prefer `Changed` vs `Fixed` in one-liners? My change touches runtime/autoscale.

Alex: Use the keep-a-changelog categories: Added, Changed, Fixed, Deprecated, Removed, Security. For runtime infra go with 'Changed' or 'Fixed' as appropriate. Keep it one line and include PR#.

Sara: FYI my PR is #842, version bump to 0.9.3, changelog entry ready. Here's the snippet I plan to add:
```
- Changed: improve KV cache eviction to reduce host memory spikes (eng-runtime) — #842
```

Liam: @Sara that's fine. Small nit: drop parentheses around component, put it after dash? We usually do: `- Changed: ... (eng-runtime) — #842` is ok. Also please add a docs note if API surface changed.

Sara: Updated to match template, added docs note. Thanks.

Jamie: I pushed a tiny fix, PR #859, will add entry. Can someone confirm whether we also need a prerelease entry for Dedicated? It's just a logging tweak.

Alex: If it's internal infra and no user-facing behavior, put it under 'Changed' with '(internal)' tag. No separate Dedicated entry unless customer-visible.

deploy-bot: Reminder — release-candidate branch build passed CI at 1762345600. :white_check_mark:

Liam: Heads-up for reviewers: please look for entries that mention migrations or backward-incompatible changes. Tag @Sara or @Jamie for quick reviews.

Alex: Thanks — 2h left. If you haven't added an entry, please do so now. I'll compile and lint changelog at cutoff. :memo:
